Taeglyn, named in-game as Dead Elf, whose corpse is in the Shattered Sanctum of the Goblin Camp in Act One.

Involvement

Act One

Taeglyn's corpse was crushed beneath rocks in the Worg Pens at X: 416 Y: -46. Using  Speak with Dead reveals that he was attempting to escape the goblin prison by digging a tunnel, but the tunnel collapsed and trapped him in rubble.

Speak with Dead

  • Who are you?
    • Dead Elf
      Taeglyn... carpenter. Father of two.
  • How did you end up here?
    • Dead Elf
      Heading to... Baldur's Gate. Didn't hear... goblin patrol.
  • Why is there a heart on one of your shoes?
    • Dead Elf
      My son Galean... did it. If I ever missed him... could look down and... remember him.
  • There's a bear in one of the other cells. Where did it come from?
    • Dead Elf
      Not... bear.
  • Were you the only prisoner here?
    • Dead Elf
      Goblins took... my friends. Cut them up... for the worgs. For meat.
  • How did you get trapped in the tunnel?
    • Dead Elf
      Digging... too quickly. Felt tunnel... collapsing. Kept going. Better dead than... worg meat.
